title: Password Manager - Alerts for breached websites
description: Learn how to receive alerts about passwords for breached websites and protect your accounts from security threats.
content:
Stay informed about security threats to your accounts with password breach alerts. These alerts notify you when your passwords may have been compromised in data breaches, helping you take immediate action to protect your accounts.

Security Alert

Password breach alerts are crucial for protecting your accounts. When you receive an alert, take immediate action to change your password and secure your account.

Important Note

Kahana does not own or operate the password breach detection service. We share this information because Oasis is built on Firefox core technology, and password breach alerts may be available in your browser. This service is provided by Mozilla Corporation.

What are Password Breach Alerts?

Password breach alerts are security notifications that inform you when your login credentials may have been exposed in a data breach. These alerts help you identify compromised accounts and take immediate action to secure them.

How Breach Detection Works

  • Monitors known data breaches
  • Compares your passwords against breached data
  • Alerts you when matches are found
  • Provides guidance on next steps
  • Helps prevent account compromise

Types of Alerts

  • Password exposure notifications
  • Account security warnings
  • Data breach summaries
  • Recommended actions
  • Security best practices

How Password Breach Alerts Work

When password breach detection is enabled, your browser continuously monitors for potential security threats:

1

Continuous Monitoring

Your browser monitors known data breaches and compares them against your stored passwords and login information.

2

Threat Detection

When a potential match is found between your credentials and breached data, an alert is triggered.

3

Immediate Notification

You receive a notification about the potential breach, including details about the affected account and recommended actions.

Managing Breach Alerts

Receiving Alerts

  • Alerts appear in your browser's security dashboard
  • Notifications may appear as browser alerts
  • Email notifications for critical breaches
  • In-browser security warnings
  • Password manager integration alerts

Responding to Alerts

  • Change passwords immediately for affected accounts
  • Enable two-factor authentication where possible
  • Monitor accounts for suspicious activity
  • Update security questions and recovery options
  • Consider using a password manager

Security Best Practices

Password Security

  • Use unique passwords for each account
  • Create strong, complex passwords
  • Regularly update your passwords
  • Use a password manager
  • Enable two-factor authentication

Account Protection

  • Monitor account activity regularly
  • Set up account recovery options
  • Use security questions wisely
  • Keep contact information updated
  • Review privacy settings

What to Do When You Receive an Alert

1

Assess the Threat

Review the alert details to understand which account is affected and the nature of the breach.

2

Change Your Password

Immediately change the password for the affected account using a strong, unique password.

3

Enable Additional Security

Set up two-factor authentication and review other security settings for the account.

4

Monitor for Suspicious Activity

Watch for any unusual activity on the account and report any suspicious behavior.

Preventing Future Breaches

Proactive Measures

  • Use a password manager to generate strong passwords
  • Enable two-factor authentication on all accounts
  • Regularly review and update security settings
  • Be cautious with phishing attempts
  • Keep software and browsers updated

Ongoing Monitoring

  • Regularly check for breach alerts
  • Monitor account activity and statements
  • Review privacy and security settings
  • Stay informed about security threats
  • Use security tools and services

What to Expect

When using password breach alerts, you may experience:

Security Benefits

  • Early warning of compromised accounts
  • Reduced risk of account takeover
  • Better password security awareness
  • Proactive security measures
  • Peace of mind about account security

Considerations

  • May receive alerts for old breaches
  • Need to act quickly on notifications
  • Requires regular password updates
  • May need to manage multiple accounts
  • Should maintain security best practices

Getting Help

For detailed instructions on managing password breach alerts and account security, visit Mozilla's official support guide:

Mozilla Lockwise Alerts Guide

Technical Details

Password breach detection uses advanced security technology to protect your accounts:

How Detection Works

  • Database Monitoring: Continuously monitors known breach databases
  • Secure Comparison: Safely compares your credentials against breached data
  • Real-time Alerts: Provides immediate notifications when threats are detected
  • Privacy Protection: Ensures your data remains secure during the process
  • Automated Scanning: Runs background checks without interrupting your browsing

Since Oasis is built on Firefox core technology, password breach alerts may be available in your browser, providing essential security protection for your accounts.
